map.估算点声源随距离的声压级衰减。: Estimate the sound pressure level attenuation of a point source with distance.
map.声源处声压级 dB: Sound pressure level at the source (dB)
map.未考虑空气吸收和地面效应。: Air absorption and ground effects are not considered.
map.厂界预测：录入源强与距离，估算某点噪声级是否达标。: Boundary prediction: enter the source strength and distance to estimate whether the level at a given point complies.
map.衰减演示：演示距离翻倍声级降约 6 dB 的规律。: Attenuation demo: show that doubling the distance lowers the level by about 6 dB.
map.教学演示：演示点源自由场衰减模型。: Teaching demo: illustrate the free-field point-source attenuation model.
map.示例：源处 80 dB、距 10 m 处约 80−20lg(10/r₁)；若 r: Example: 80 dB at the source gives about 80−20lg(10/r₁) at 10 m; with r₁=1 the level at 10 m is ≈ 60 dB (a 20 dB drop).
map.为什么距离翻倍降 6 dB？: Why does doubling the distance drop the level by 6 dB?
map.点源声强随面积 1/r² 衰减，声级 10lg(1/r²)=−20lg r，翻倍: Point-source intensity falls with area as 1/r², so the level is 10lg(1/r²) = −20lg r; doubling the distance gives −6 dB. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
